prompt:
Codex image tool, transparent_background: true, one call for the whole 3x3 sheet (design/mascot/prompts/glances.txt), registered on the directions sheet's centre cell into this atlas by design/mascot/web-atlas.py. Prompt: The attached image is a 3x3 head-direction sprite sheet of Kaatu. Produce a MATCHING 3x3 sheet for that same character. The character is Kaatu, a cute chubby young beaver mascot: warm deep-amber fur (#DD8636, with a darker amber shade #BE6A22), a soft cream (#F6EBDD) muzzle, two big rounded cream buck teeth, a small rose-pink (#F26A90) nose, soft rose cheek circles, very small rounded ears set low on the sides of the head with rose-brown inner ears, small dark chocolate bead eyes each with a tiny white highlight, a wide, soft, slightly flat-topped head with full round cheeks, a neat flat ring collar of four short rounded segments with small gaps (left to right across the front: teal #3CC2B4, marigold #FAAB3F, rose #F26A90, soft violet #9E8CF4), a seated round body with ONE clean cream (#F6EBDD) oval tummy patch that nothing covers, two short chubby amber ARMS hanging relaxed down the two SIDES of the body, each ending in a small rounded amber paw resting against the hip with tiny finger notches (nothing is ever held in front of the chest), and a chocolate-brown (#7A4A2E) flat paddle tail peeking up behind one hip, never reaching past the side of the head. Copy the character from the attached image exactly: the same colours, the same cream muzzle and buck teeth, the same rose nose and cheeks, the same small low ears, the same four-segment collar, the same round body and clean tummy oval, the same arms and paws, the same peeking tail, the same flat outline-free style. Do not restyle, simplify or redraw it. Flat vector illustration in a modern, friendly app-mascot style: built only from simple soft rounded shapes, with NO outlines and NO strokes anywhere. Flat solid colour fills; each colour has exactly one soft, slightly darker shade shape for gentle depth. No gradients, no texture, no glossy highlights except one tiny white highlight in each eye. Very cute and expressive, with clear, simple face shapes that read at small sizes. Polished and distinctive, like a well-designed brand mascot, not clip art. Match the attached reference image exactly.

This sheet holds IN-BETWEEN frames for smooth animation: SMALL head turns, much smaller than in the attached sheet. In the attached sheet the outer cells are FULL turns, where the nose reaches the edge of the face and one eye nearly disappears. Here every turn is SUBTLE: start from the centre cell of the attached sheet (head straight at the viewer) and turn the head only a LITTLE toward the cell's direction. In every cell here BOTH eyes stay fully visible and round, BOTH cheeks show, the muzzle stays near the middle of the face, and the nose sits only about ONE NOSE-WIDTH off the centre of the face in the direction named. For "up" the eyes, nose and muzzle sit a little HIGHER on the face than in the centre cell; for "down" a little LOWER. Calm happy face with open eyes, the same as the attached sheet.

Cells, left to right, top to bottom (cell 5 is the only different one):
1. a little up and to the left. 2. a little up. 3. a little up and to the right.
4. a little to the left. 5. STRAIGHT at the viewer, eyes HALF CLOSED and drowsy (only in this cell): in each eye the upper half of the dark bead is covered by a flat amber eyelid, so a straight lid edge runs across the middle of the eye; same small smile. 6. a little to the right.
7. a little down and to the left. 8. a little down, eyes OPEN. 9. a little down and to the right.
The body never turns. No floating symbols.

CRITICAL: same art style, same palette, same proportions, and EXACTLY THE SAME SIZE AND POSITION IN THE CELL as the attached sheet. The collar, the body, the tummy patch, the tail and the seat must be the same drawing, the same width, and the same height off the bottom of the cell as in the attached sheet, identical in all nine cells here. If the sheets do not line up the character visibly jumps when the animation switches between them, so match them.

Wide margin on all four sides; nothing touches or crosses a cell edge, including raised paws, props and floating symbols, and keep clear empty space below the body. Any floating symbol is SMALL, FLAT (no outline, no gradient) and sits entirely inside its OWN cell, close beside or just above the head.

No text, no labels, no borders, no drop shadows, no background colour.
Square image, at least 1024x1024, PNG WITH A REAL ALPHA CHANNEL. The background must be genuinely transparent, not white.
